ev.q: The age-adjusted percentage of adults who had serious psychological distress decreased with increasing family income
Age-Adjusted Percentage* of Adults Aged ≥18 Years with Serious Psychological Distress During the Past 30 Days
from 8.9% of adults with family income <100% of FPL, to 5.8% of adults with family income 100%–199% of FPL
Age-adjusted percentages are based on the 2000 U.S. Census Bureau standard population
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population.

methods_quotes.q: Age-adjusted percentages are based on the 2000 U.S. Census Bureau standard population
Family income was imputed when missing using multiple imputation methodology.
Only respondents who answered all six questions were included in the analysis.
